question.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

exchange.sent: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar use case, the passages do not directly place a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester inside the radar echo workflow; they support using it around the communications and RF-parametric parts of the platform, while radar echo / target simulation is covered by radar-specific tools such as AREG800A for FMCW radar echo generation [21].
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow block | Fit of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar / EME environment definition | A&D radar-related EMC/EME work is framed as RF electromagnetic environment emulation, system-level EM interference evaluation, and operational scenario simulation, not as a signaling-tester workflow [13]. | [13] |
| RF susceptibility around radar emitters | DO-160 Section 20 covers RF susceptibility when the EUT is exposed to RF modulated power, and it explicitly lists external radiators such as radar stations as possible emission sources [16]. | [16] |
| Radar target / echo simulation | AREG800A is the supported radar-specific instrument in the passages, with dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar echo generation up to 3000 m [21]. | [21] |
| Communications subsystem testing | A Signaling Tester fits when the A&D platform or UAV has LTE, 5G, or Wi‑Fi communications to test, because CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, BLER, throughput, PER, IP traffic, application tests, and protocol-related workflows [1]. | [1] |
| UAV / platform radio link validation | The UAV signaling-test passage says CMX500 provides LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling tests, including RF measurements such as power, frequency, spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER, MIMO, plus application-layer and protocol tests [38]. | [38] |
| Non-signaling RF / waveform work | CMX500 GPRF Generator is the supported non-signaling CMX500 use case, generating ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [40]. | [40] |
| Production-style non-signaling RF test | CMP180 is positioned for production / wireless communication device testing and supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing with multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture [5]. | [5] |
| WLAN production non-signaling test | In WLAN device production, the passages say RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned as optimized for that purpose [59]. | [59] |
### Inference
【推論】Put the Non-signaling Tester in RF parametric, waveform replay, standalone TX measurement, or production-style RF checks for the communications/RF chain, while using radar-specific echo-generation equipment for the radar sensor path [21][40][59].

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。

- Create a signaling environment by transmitting an [[FR3]] cell signal at 13 GHz, simulating real-world conditions。
- Conduct comprehensive analysis, verifying the device's ability to achieve maximum throughput in the [[FR3]] frequency range。

### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar use case, the passages do not directly place a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester inside the radar echo workflow; they support using it around the communications and RF-parametric parts of the platform, while radar echo / target simulation is covered by radar-specific tools such as AREG800A for FMCW radar echo generation [21].
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow block | Fit of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar / EME environment definition | A&D radar-related EMC/EME work is framed as RF electromagnetic environment emulation, system-level EM interference evaluation, and operational scenario simulation, not as a signaling-tester workflow [13]. | [13] |
| RF susceptibility around radar emitters | DO-160 Section 20 covers RF susceptibility when the EUT is exposed to RF modulated power, and it explicitly lists external radiators such as radar stations as possible emission sources [16]. | [16] |
| Radar target / echo simulation | AREG800A is the supported radar-specific instrument in the passages, with dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar echo generation up to 3000 m [21]. | [21] |
| Communications subsystem testing | A Signaling Tester fits when the A&D platform or UAV has LTE, 5G, or Wi‑Fi communications to test, because CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, BLER, throughput, PER, IP traffic, application tests, and protocol-related workflows [1]. | [1] |
| UAV / platform radio link validation | The UAV signaling-test passage says CMX500 provides LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling tests, including RF measurements such as power, frequency, spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER, MIMO, plus application-layer and protocol tests [38]. | [38] |
| Non-signaling RF / waveform work | CMX500 GPRF Generator is the supported non-signaling CMX500 use case, generating ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [40]. | [40] |
| Production-style non-signaling RF test | CMP180 is positioned for production / wireless communication device testing and supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing with multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture [5]. | [5] |
| WLAN production non-signaling test | In WLAN device production, the passages say RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned as optimized for that purpose [59]. | [59] |
### Inference
【推論】Put the Non-signaling Tester in RF parametric, waveform replay, standalone TX measurement, or production-style RF checks for the communications/RF chain, while using radar-specific echo-generation equipment for the radar sensor path [21][40][59].

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 25 — Electrostatic Discharge
來源說此測試確保 equipment able to withstand an air discharged electromagnetic pulse，並指出 static electricity charges can result from human contact；contributing factors include low humidity、low temperature、low conductivity、carpets、vinyl seats and plastic structures。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[RTCA DO-160]] 正式標準摘要；只保存 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 的簡報文字。
- 不得由本頁推論 DO-160G / DO-160 任何 section 的完整 category、limit、waveform、test setup 或 pass / fail criteria。
- 來源把 DO-160 放在 military / aviation drone example 中，但未說明特定 drone、eVTOL 或 avionics equipment 的 qualification plan。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 15 — Magnetic Effect
來源說 Section 15 concern 為 equipment magnetic effect，目標是 finding or proving the closest distance to compasses or compass sensors（flux gates）at which that unit is allowed to be installed。

來源列出 classification：Cat Y、Cat Z、Cat A、Cat B、Class C，其中 Cat Y 被描述為 equipment next to navigation compass，Class C 被描述為 equipment >3.0 m from navigation compass。來源未提供完整 category definition。

RF transfer characteristics 量測條件：with diplexer between RX and TX，frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，window function normal gate（Hann），type bandpass filter，measured from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector。

- Amplitude flatness：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] `< ±1 dB in 1 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±2 dB in 2 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±5 dB in 4 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`。
- Group delay flatness：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] `< ±0.5 ns in 1 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±1 ns in 2 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±1 ns in 4 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`。

- RF frequency range：`24.0 GHz to 24.25 GHz`。
- RF instantaneous bandwidth：`250 MHz`。
- IF center frequency：`825 MHz for 250 MHz bandwidth`。
- Maximum number supported：`4`；one IF path per [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] option required。

answer.text:
### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar use case, the passages do not directly place a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester inside the radar echo workflow; they support using it around the communications and RF-parametric parts of the platform, while radar echo / target simulation is covered by radar-specific tools such as AREG800A for FMCW radar echo generation [21].
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow block | Fit of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar / EME environment definition | A&D radar-related EMC/EME work is framed as RF electromagnetic environment emulation, system-level EM interference evaluation, and operational scenario simulation, not as a signaling-tester workflow [13]. | [13] |
| RF susceptibility around radar emitters | DO-160 Section 20 covers RF susceptibility when the EUT is exposed to RF modulated power, and it explicitly lists external radiators such as radar stations as possible emission sources [16]. | [16] |
| Radar target / echo simulation | AREG800A is the supported radar-specific instrument in the passages, with dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar echo generation up to 3000 m [21]. | [21] |
| Communications subsystem testing | A Signaling Tester fits when the A&D platform or UAV has LTE, 5G, or Wi‑Fi communications to test, because CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, BLER, throughput, PER, IP traffic, application tests, and protocol-related workflows [1]. | [1] |
| UAV / platform radio link validation | The UAV signaling-test passage says CMX500 provides LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling tests, including RF measurements such as power, frequency, spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER, MIMO, plus application-layer and protocol tests [38]. | [38] |
| Non-signaling RF / waveform work | CMX500 GPRF Generator is the supported non-signaling CMX500 use case, generating ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [40]. | [40] |
| Production-style non-signaling RF test | CMP180 is positioned for production / wireless communication device testing and supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing with multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture [5]. | [5] |
| WLAN production non-signaling test | In WLAN device production, the passages say RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned as optimized for that purpose [59]. | [59] |
### Inference
【推論】Put the Non-signaling Tester in RF parametric, waveform replay, standalone TX measurement, or production-style RF checks for the communications/RF chain, while using radar-specific echo-generation equipment for the radar sensor path [21][40][59].

cited_passages.text:
R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › Complex EME emulation
來源的 RF electromagnetic environment 章節列出：

- emulate complex EME signals。
- enable the military electromagnetic spectrum operation。
- emulating different electromagnetic environment。
- evaluating military system level effects under EM interferences。
- simulating different operational scenarios。

這支持 [[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 的客製化測試方向，但來源未提供 signal library、scenario definition、threat emitter model、功率、頻段、同步或安全條件。

cited_passages.text:
DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

UAV signaling test solution › CMX500 可涵蓋的 signaling test 範圍
依 [[Signaling test solution]]，[[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 400 MHz 至 8 GHz，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test。來源列出的測試類別包含：

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

使用限制：來源未說明 test case、standard version、release、channel bandwidth、MIMO layers、OTA / conducted setup、automation interface、pass / fail limit 或 measurement uncertainty。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。
